name: Arctic Restaurant Service & Supply
old_description: Delivery Available  In Business Since 1973  Authorized Warranty Providers for Major Brands
about:
Arctic Restaurant Service & Supply has operated from Madisonville, Kentucky since 1973. The company was founded as a family-owned business and remains under family ownership today, serving the western Kentucky region and surrounding areas.

The company supplies commercial cooking equipment, refrigeration systems, and a full range of restaurant supplies including cookware and tableware. It carries major brands such as Vulcan, Duke, Blodgett, Henny Penny, True Manufacturing, Victory Refrigeration, and Delfield. Beyond sales, Arctic provides installation, planned maintenance, 24/7 emergency repair, and a parts department that stocks inventory and can special-order items typically within three to four business days. The business also rents refrigerated trailers for events and seasonal needs, and offers commercial HVAC services.

Arctic serves a broad spectrum of foodservice operations, from small cafes and catering outfits to large commercial kitchens in hotels, schools, and healthcare facilities. Its customer base includes restaurants, hotels, educational institutions, and medical centers across western Kentucky.

The company emphasizes its status as an authorized warranty provider for major brands, with factory-trained, licensed, and insured technicians. It differentiates itself through 24/7 emergency response, free delivery within a 60-mile radius for trailer rentals, and a local, family-owned presence spanning more than five decades.

name: Arizona Automotive Equipment
old_description: Arizona Automotive Equipment, commonly known in the area as Mohawk Automotive Lifts Southwest, has been serving the Southwest region of the United States since 2004. We are a family-run operation that maintains the highest quality and standards while giving you the personal touch that often gets lost in today’s day and age.
about:
Arizona Automotive Equipment, also known as Mohawk Automotive Lifts Southwest, has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 2004. The company was founded by Mike and Karen Green to provide annual lift safety inspections and detailed reports for OSHA compliance. In January 2021, ownership passed to Jason and Brandi Byers, a husband-and-wife team who continue the family-run legacy.

The business supplies heavy-duty automotive lifts and equipment for commercial shops and personal garages, carrying brands such as Mohawk Lifts, Hunter Engineering, Challenger Lifts, Tuxedo Lifts, and Samson. Its product range includes two-post, four-post, mobile column, scissor, and specialty lifts for vehicles from passenger cars to heavy-duty trucks. In addition to sales, the company provides ALI-certified lift inspections and in-house installation services performed by its own technicians.

Customers span automotive repair shops, commercial garages, fleet maintenance operations, and personal garage owners throughout the Southwest. The company's inspectors are qualified to examine any lift regardless of manufacturer, brand, or age, issuing serialized ALI inspection labels that serve as proof of compliance for code enforcement.

The Byerses emphasize a personal-touch approach, offering personalized service, a comprehensive catalog, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Their ALI-certified inspectors and focus on OSHA compliance differentiate the business in a market where safety certification is often a minimum requirement.

name: Arizona Fabrication Solutions
old_description: Located in the heart of Queen Creek, Arizona. We are a veteran family owned and operated business, providing all of your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Arizona Fabrication Solutions is based in Queen Creek, Arizona, and was founded in 2013. The company is veteran-owned and family-operated, established by Army veteran Shannon Miazga and Arizona native Bobby Padilla. Miazga brings 12 years of military leadership and 13 years of production management experience, while Padilla contributes local knowledge and a hands-on approach to fabrication.

The shop specializes in custom architectural and structural steel fabrication for residential and commercial construction projects across Arizona. Core services include stair railing replacement and installation, gate fabrication (including entry gates, rolling gates, and block wall removal for larger openings), and custom metal ornamentals such as indoor furniture and outdoor trellises. The team works with architectural and structural steel to deliver tailored metalwork for builders and homeowners.

Primary customers are in the residential and commercial construction sectors, including contractors, architects, and property owners throughout Arizona. Projects range from single-family home railing upgrades to commercial gate installations and decorative metal accents for both interior and exterior applications.

The company emphasizes its veteran-owned, family-operated structure as a differentiator, highlighting a commitment to custom projects and direct client collaboration. Miazga’s background in production management and military leadership informs the shop’s focus on precision and reliability in every fabrication job.

name: Arizona Mobile Meat Processing
old_description: Hi my name is Jake Giles and I am the Owner/Operator of Arizona Mobile Meat Processing.  I have been cutting meat for over 20 years and have a great deal of pride doing what I do.  I started Arizona Mobile Meat Processing in 2009 here in Northern Arizona.
about:
Arizona Mobile Meat Processing operates from Williams, Arizona, where founder Jake Giles launched the business in 2009 after two decades of cutting meat. Giles serves as owner and operator of the mobile processing service, which travels to ranches and homes across northern Arizona to handle domestic livestock.

The company runs a state‑inspected facility approved for resale and carries commercial inspection from the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA). Its mobile unit provides on‑site slaughter, cutting, and wrapping for beef, lamb, goats, and swine, while a separate wild‑game division processes antelope, deer, elk, and javelina during hunting seasons. The fixed location complements the mobile operation.

Customers include ranchers, hunting families, and local 4‑H clubs that the company sponsors. The service covers domestic livestock for private owners and auction participants (Coconino, Maricopa, Verde Valley, Yavapai county auctions) as well as hunters seeking custom processing of harvested game.

Giles started the business out of pride in his craft and a desire to bring inspected, convenient processing directly to producers and hunters in the region.

name: Arizona Plastics Machinery
old_description: is the largest U.S.-based manufacturer of industry-leading drying, conveying, and complete materials-handling systems for the plastics industry.
about:
Arizona Plastics Machinery (APM) operates from Oracle, Arizona, where it was founded in 1983 by Craig, a plastics technology and business graduate who has supplied equipment to the plastics industry since that year. The company began as a manufacturers' representative focused on plastics processing equipment.

APM represents a portfolio of equipment suppliers covering the full spectrum of plastics processing. Its line card includes Haitian injection molding machines ranging from 44 to 7,456 tons; Novatec drying, blending, and resin-handling systems; Thermal Care process cooling equipment such as chillers, temperature controllers, and cooling towers; Rapid Granulator size-reduction machinery for recycling and in-line applications; Harvard Factory Automation conveyor systems; Kosmek hydraulic, pneumatic, and magnetic clamping systems; Santa Fe Machine plasticizing components including screws, barrels, and tip assemblies; Ensign bulk material handling equipment; and TEKLEEN self-cleaning water filters. Beyond product representation, APM provides technical consulting, equipment selection assistance, production-line optimization, and troubleshooting support.

The firm serves plastics processors across injection molding, extrusion, recycling, and general plastics manufacturing. Customers range from molders seeking auxiliary equipment to plants needing complete material-handling, cooling, or automation solutions.

APM differentiates itself through the breadth of its equipment offerings, the hands-on expertise of its founder, and long-standing partnerships with manufacturers that emphasize durability and performance.

old_description: We are a family owned, faith based, full-service residential and commercial electrical contracting company. Providing new construction, remodels, smart home conversions, upgrades repairs and much more. Our team is committed to providing high-quality standards of integrity and exceptional customer service. As an East Mountains company, this grants us the ability to have personable relations with our clients. about:
Ark Electrical LLC is a family-owned, faith-based electrical contracting company based in Cedar Crest, New Mexico, in the East Mountains region. The business was founded in 2019 by Master Electrician Juan Fernandez, who launched the company after eleven years of hands-on experience in the trade with a mission to bring faith-based honesty, reliability, and quality electrical services to his neighbors.

The company provides full-service residential and commercial electrical work, including new construction, remodels, smart-home conversions, service upgrades, panel replacements, backup generator installation, EV charger installation, and general electrical repairs. Operating with a small team that includes a senior electrical specialist and an apprentice, Ark Electrical emphasizes quality craftsmanship, upfront flat-rate pricing, and a "do it once and do it right" approach on every job.

Ark Electrical serves homeowners and businesses throughout Sandia Park, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Edgewood, and the greater Albuquerque area. Its residential clients rely on the firm for everything from improving the safety of older electrical systems to integrating modern smart-home technology, while commercial customers engage the company for new builds and remodel projects.

Fernandez started Ark Electrical to combine his trade expertise with values rooted in faith, integrity, honesty, commitment, and respect. The company states that it stands behind its work, prioritizes clear communication, and aims to build lasting relationships with the families and communities it serves.

name: Arkansas Catering Cabot Arkansas
old_description: Arkansas Full-Service Catering for Corporate Events, Weddings & Private Gatherings
about:
Arkansas Catering operates from Cabot, Arkansas, and was founded in 2003 by Chef Wayne Schilleci. Schilleci built his career owning and operating restaurants across the state before launching the catering business, bringing restaurant-level execution to off-site events.

The company provides full-service catering for corporate functions, weddings, and private gatherings throughout Central Arkansas. Menus span breakfast, hors d'oeuvres, lunch, dinner, and dessert, with a specialty in Cajun-inspired dishes such as shrimp creole, crawfish étouffée, and blackened white fish. The team handles delivery, setup, service, and cleanup, scaling from intimate meals to events serving hundreds of guests without a drop in quality or timing. Private chef-style service is also available, bringing on-site preparation and presentation to homes or corporate venues.

Corporate clients use the service for executive lunches, leadership meetings, grand openings, employee appreciation events, and large conferences or banquets. Wedding clients range from intimate ceremonies to full receptions. Private events include birthdays, anniversaries, baby and bridal showers, holiday parties, and family reunions. The company notes a 5-star reputation across hundreds of events served.

Schilleci started the business to offer "Food with Heart. Service with Standards." — a phrase that reflects his emphasis on generous, flavorful food crafted with care and a calm, professional process from the first quote through final cleanup. His decades of restaurant experience inform every menu, timeline, and service detail.

name: Arkansas Food Equipment
old_description: Since 1991, our value has always been in our quality work. Our repair services are provided by factory-trained service technicians with much industry experience.
about:
Arkansas Food Equipment has operated from Cabot, Arkansas since 1991. The company began as a sales and service provider for commercial meat processing equipment, building a reputation for quality work performed by factory-trained technicians.

The business focuses on on-site repair of food service equipment, with fully stocked service vehicles that enable prompt repairs and minimal downtime. Technicians service a wide range of machines including meat grinders, slicers, saws, tenderizers, wrappers, patty machines, vacuum packers, scales, bread slicers, and pressure washers. The company also sells supply items such as vacuum bags, seasonings, saw blades, clips, and ties, and offers preventative maintenance contracts to reduce unexpected breakdowns.

Customers include meat processors, grocery stores, and food service operations that rely on equipment like check stands, electronic shopping carts, and cart retrievers. The service area covers central Arkansas, with technicians traveling to client sites for repairs and scheduled maintenance.

The company emphasizes its long-standing commitment to quality since 1991, highlighting factory-trained technicians and fully stocked vehicles as key differentiators that keep client operations running with minimal interruption.

about:
Arkansas Metal Products operates from Bald Knob, Arkansas, as a veteran-owned, family-operated metal fabrication shop. The company emphasizes its 40 years of collective experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including plasma and laser profiling, welding, tube and bar processing, forming, drilling, and crane-assisted handling. Design work is supported by AutoCAD, SigmaNEST, SketchUp, and SolidWorks. The facility also offers custom coating through its AMP Custom Coating line. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Arkansas Metal Products serves a mix of industrial clients and outdoor recreation customers. Its AMP Outdoor Outfitters line targets hunters and outdoor enthusiasts with locally made gear, while the core fabrication business works to customer specifications across various sectors.

The company states that its lean-minded staff focuses on surpassing expectations for craftsmanship and customer service, and that its quality management system addresses not only the final product but the processes used to achieve it.
